title: Simple Totem Limiter
description: Just makes totems drop on the ground when you have more than the set amount.
body:
### Description
This datapack simply drops totems out of players inventories when they go over the max number of totems.




### Commands
```
/scoreboard players set $max_totems max_totems {Number}
```
  Sets the max number of totems in each players inventory.
